title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Revelation 7: the four angels, the sealing of the hundred forty-four thousand and the great multitude before the throne.

questions.text: What were the four angels standing at the four corners of the earth holding?
questions.explanation: They were holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

answers.text: The four winds of the earth

questions.text: What did the angel who ascended from the sunrise have?
questions.explanation: John saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God.

answers.text: The seal of the living God

questions.text: Where were the bondservants of God to be sealed?
questions.explanation: The angel called out that the earth, the sea and the trees should not be harmed until the bondservants of God were sealed on their foreheads.

questions.text: What number of sealed people did John hear?
questions.explanation: He heard the number of those who were sealed: one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel.

questions.text: How many were sealed out of each tribe that is listed?
questions.explanation: The list says of each tribe, from Judah to Benjamin, that twelve thousand were sealed.

questions.text: What did the great multitude have in their hands?
questions.explanation: The great multitude stood before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

questions.text: What did the angels, the elders and the four living creatures do before the throne?
questions.explanation: They fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God, saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever!”

answers.text: They sang the song of Moses
They fell on their faces and worshiped God
They sealed the servants of God

questions.text: According to the elder, how did those in white robes make their robes white?
questions.explanation: The elder said that these came out of the great suffering, and that they washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

answers.text: They washed them in the springs of living water
They washed them in the Lamb’s blood
They were given new robes by the angels
They washed them in a sea of glass

questions.text: What does the text say those before the throne of God do?
questions.explanation: They are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple, and he who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

answers.text: They reign on thrones of their own
They guard the gates of the holy city
They measure the temple and the altar
They serve God day and night in his temple

questions.text: Where does the Lamb lead those he shepherds?
questions.explanation: The Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters.

answers.text: To the sea of glass mixed with fire
